item.title: Build up of rubbish, 13th September
item.description:
For months, consistently, a substantial quantity of waste, including food waste, has been left outside the front of the property and across the pavement. The house is an HMO and the bins are rarely put out meaning bins don’t get taken and waste builds up

item.title: Making access to houses and driveways in the close difficult, 13th September
item.description:
This large van has been parked there for 8 months and has only moved once and in that time they reserved the space with one of their other cars. Everyone on the street is all agreeing that they are finding it difficult to drive down the street and get in their driveways. The vehicle is parked across from number 6 but number 2 owns it. They began to ask other people to move out the way for them to park their large vehicle there. Bin lorries are unable to make it down the street and everyone in the road is worried that emergency vehicles won’t be able to access homes. All the cars can barely fit past and we are all scared of damaging our cars attempting to pass
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Shorne Close, Blendon, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
